title: 1.41 update is a pain!
body:
Yesterday all was well. Had my premium version, tracking several habits. Today, updated to 1.41.0, and it keeps asking me to purchase the premium version! I say restore purchase, it says ok, it keeps bugging me to buy premium!! Was a great app, now is a great pain in the arse!

It got worse! Updated to latest version and it lost all my data. Why can’t I rate 0 stars?!?
author: ハリススティーブ

title: Great app
body: I payed and upgraded to premium, but the app has changed nothing from free plan!! Please fix the large bug... for my money...
author: totemOyokatta

title: Is there a way to stop the upgrade offer?
body:
I've compared several apps and it's great because the UI is stylish and it's easy to see in a week if I've achieved or not.
I'm happy with just managing the three habits so I want to continue using the free plan, but I'm always getting an upgrade offer to the premium plan so it's too annoying to cancel it every time. Is there a way to stop this?
author: tkhmhiroc

title: Great app
body:
I love the design, works well and most important I love that it’s a one time payment. Seems the developer is actively continuing development for the app, so I highly recommend this app. 

Looking forward to additional features. Most wanted for me: iOS 14 widget and Siri Shortcuts 🙏😆
author: unko_man

title: Goood
body:
Simple and easy to use. I like the colour in the app! 
I hope the app will include Siri Shortcut feature someday so I can automate my routine.
author: りりーふらわー

title: 使いやすい！
body: パッとチェックしやすく（過去の日付もできる）細かい統計も見やすくて、シンプルかつ機能的でとても良いです。faceIDに対応してもらえたら最高です。
author: コメメメ

title: シンプルでかっこいい
body: デザインに惹かれて使い始めましたが、余計な機能が煩わしくなく、シンプルで進捗が見やすくて使いやすいです。その日一日というより、数日後のトータルでの達成具合が視覚的に分かりやすい。
author: bird-and-moon

title: デザインが好き
body:
バレットジャーナルのdaily tasksのかわりになるアプリを探していて見つけました。デザインもかわいいし、操作性も好きです。

このくらいシンプルな機能で充分です。
author: suzi00
